`final class UIPropertyHook`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.hook.property` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIPropertyHook.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/hook/property/UIPropertyHook.java)

Reads and writes the `@UIProperty` fields of a UI in its property file.

## Description

JOID calls it for you when a UI opens, reloads and closes, and when the JVM stops.
A field that cannot be read keeps its default value, and a field that cannot be saved keeps its previous value in the file; both print a warning.

## Learn more

- [Stores and properties](/use/learn/state/stores-and-properties/#remember-a-field-of-a-ui)

| `void` | [save](#UIPropertyHook-method-save)(UI ui) <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span> | Writes every `@UIProperty` field of the UI to its property file; a `null` field removes its key. |
